prior_observation.methodological_limit: All 12 routed requests in v0.1 had identical prompt hashes. v0.1 only shows duplicated policy-overhead, not case-sensitive routing.

question: With case-specific non-oracle contract descriptions, does a pinned local model's decision to invoke the same verifier change correctness or latency compared with fixed and declarative routing?
scope: Twelve exact public internal FAR finite contracts; no independent held-out general reasoning benchmark.
frozen_sources: research/architecture-routing/protocol-v0.1.json; each case bound to listed Git blob SHA

design.expected_behavior: All 12 are explicit, supported verifier inputs. Running verifier is admissible for all. The model may only tie fixed correctness or decrease it by abstaining.

primary: correctness of derived FAR outcome versus frozen project-authored reference labels
nonclaims: No model adaptation proof without varying valid route choices
No proven deterministic vs declarative micro-latency edge
